name: Prince Albert
terroir: Prince Albert district sits on the northern (Karoo) side of the Swartberg range, in the Great Karoo, drained by the seasonal Dorps River and irrigated historically via a 19th-century furrow system off the mountain. The district's three demarcated wards — Kweekvallei, Prince Albert Valley, Swartberg.
